clauses.quote: A complete plan for such study must be approved and filed with the original application.
clauses.subject_text: A complete plan for such study

clauses.quote: The unit member shall remain in travel status three and one-half (3½) months for each semester of leave granted.
Unit members meeting the following criteria may, at the discretion of the District, be granted a leave once in every eight (8) years.
clauses.subject_text: Unit members meeting the following criteria
clauses.notes: Conditional permission contingent on district discretion.

clauses.quote: An approval by a physician that the unit member is in good physical condition shall be required.
clauses.subject_text: An approval by a physician that the unit member is in good physical condition

clauses.quote: Expenses incurred will be the responsibility of the unit member.
Sabbatical leaves shall be granted for not less than one (1) full semester or more than two (2) consecutive semesters.
Leave for a fractional part of a semester is not permitted.
clauses.subject_text: Leave for a fractional part of a semester
